name: Leverette's Barber Shop
lead: Family-run since 1967. Owner Cynthia Levy carries on the shop her mother, Ellender Leverette Tatum, took over. 4.7 stars from 40 Google reviews.
svc_text: A community directory says Leverette's has served generations of families, mainly men and some women, with current styles at moderate prices. Prices would be added with the owner.
about: Leverette's Barber Shop has been at W 79th Street in Chicago's Auburn Gresham neighborhood since 1967.
Owner Cynthia Levy credits her mother, Ellender Leverette Tatum, who took over the business from her brother-in-law after nine years of training. Barbers listed include Dawn Tatum, Charles and Rudy.
Customers have given it 4.7 stars across 40 Google reviews.
